#!/bin/bash
set -e

W="/tmp/bench76379942"
CONF="/var/lib/bench76379942/etc/containerd.toml"
PROPS="/var/lib/bench76379942/nexus/etc/nexus.properties"

# Nexus' Docker connector: the host and port of its configuration (and what ss shows), not the port of the image names
HOST=$(sed -n 's/^nexus\.docker\.docker-all\.http\.host=//p' "$PROPS")
PORT=$(sed -n 's/^nexus\.docker\.docker-all\.http\.port=//p' "$PROPS")
OLD=$(grep -o 'http://[^"]*' "$CONF" | head -1)          # the engineer's mirror endpoint, host:port where nothing listens
echo "[solution] Nexus listens on $HOST:$PORT (plain HTTP); the mirror of docker.io points at $OLD"
ss -ltn | grep -q "$HOST:$PORT" || { echo "[solution] nothing listens on $HOST:$PORT"; exit 1; }

echo "[solution] docker.io -> Nexus' real connector, and the explicit name ${OLD#http://} (the thread's port) -> the same connector; then containerd has to be restarted..."
sudo sed -i "s#endpoint = \[\"$OLD\"\]#endpoint = [\"http://$HOST:$PORT\"]#" "$CONF"
sudo tee -a "$CONF" >/dev/null <<TOML
  [plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".registry.mirrors."${OLD#http://}"]
    endpoint = ["http://$HOST:$PORT"]
TOML
sudo /var/lib/bench76379942/bin/containerdctl restart

echo "[solution] both names pull now:"
"$W/bin/node-crictl" pull bench76379942/web:1.0 | tail -1
"$W/bin/node-crictl" pull "${OLD#http://}/bench76379942/api:1.0" | tail -1

#!/bin/bash
# the registry.mirrors tables are replaced by config_path and one hosts.toml per name (a directory of its own): the upstream as `server`, Nexus' connector as the mirror host
set -e
W=/tmp/bench76379942
CONF=/var/lib/bench76379942/etc/containerd.toml
PROPS=/var/lib/bench76379942/nexus/etc/nexus.properties
HOST=$(sed -n 's/^nexus\.docker\.docker-all\.http\.host=//p' $PROPS)
PORT=$(sed -n 's/^nexus\.docker\.docker-all\.http\.port=//p' $PROPS)
EXPL=$(grep -o 'http://[^"]*' $CONF | head -1); EXPL=${EXPL#http://}
RESTART="sudo /var/lib/bench76379942/bin/containerdctl restart"
MIRRORS='[plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".registry.mirrors'
sudo sed -i '/registry\.mirrors\]/,$d' $CONF
sudo sed -i '/^[[:space:]]*config_path/d' $CONF
D=/tmp/bench76379942-hosts
sudo mkdir -p $D/docker.io $D/$EXPL
printf '  config_path = "%s"\n' $D | sudo tee -a $CONF >/dev/null
printf 'server = "https://registry-1.docker.io"\n[host."http://%s:%s"]\n  capabilities = ["pull", "resolve"]\n' $HOST $PORT | sudo tee $D/docker.io/hosts.toml >/dev/null
printf 'server = "https://%s"\n[host."http://%s:%s"]\n  capabilities = ["pull", "resolve"]\n' $EXPL $HOST $PORT | sudo tee $D/$EXPL/hosts.toml >/dev/null
$RESTART

#!/bin/bash
# the mirrors tables rewritten in one go (both names, same endpoint), then a restart
set -e
W=/tmp/bench76379942
CONF=/var/lib/bench76379942/etc/containerd.toml
PROPS=/var/lib/bench76379942/nexus/etc/nexus.properties
HOST=$(sed -n 's/^nexus\.docker\.docker-all\.http\.host=//p' $PROPS)
PORT=$(sed -n 's/^nexus\.docker\.docker-all\.http\.port=//p' $PROPS)
EXPL=$(grep -o 'http://[^"]*' $CONF | head -1); EXPL=${EXPL#http://}
RESTART="sudo /var/lib/bench76379942/bin/containerdctl restart"
MIRRORS='[plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".registry.mirrors'
sudo python3 - "$CONF" "$EXPL" "$HOST:$PORT" <<'PY'
import sys,re
p,expl,real=sys.argv[1:4]
t=open(p).read()
t=t[:t.index('[plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".registry.mirrors]')]
t+='[plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".registry.mirrors]\n'
for n in ("docker.io",expl):
    t+='  [plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".registry.mirrors."%s"]\n    endpoint = ["http://%s"]\n'%(n,real)
open(p,"w").write(t)
PY
$RESTART

#!/bin/bash
# a small TCP forwarder listens on the engineer's port and relays to the connector: the names work, the lab is changed
set -e
W=/tmp/bench76379942
CONF=/var/lib/bench76379942/etc/containerd.toml
PROPS=/var/lib/bench76379942/nexus/etc/nexus.properties
HOST=$(sed -n 's/^nexus\.docker\.docker-all\.http\.host=//p' $PROPS)
PORT=$(sed -n 's/^nexus\.docker\.docker-all\.http\.port=//p' $PROPS)
EXPL=$(grep -o 'http://[^"]*' $CONF | head -1); EXPL=${EXPL#http://}
RESTART="sudo /var/lib/bench76379942/bin/containerdctl restart"
MIRRORS='[plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".registry.mirrors'
cat > $W/fwd.py <<'PY'
import socket,threading,sys
h,p,q=sys.argv[1],int(sys.argv[2]),int(sys.argv[3])
def pipe(a,b):
    try:
        while (d:=a.recv(65536)): b.sendall(d)
    except OSError: pass
    finally:
        for s in (a,b):
            try: s.close()
            except OSError: pass
l=socket.socket(); l.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1); l.bind((h,p)); l.listen(64)
while True:
    c,_=l.accept(); u=socket.create_connection((h,q))
    threading.Thread(target=pipe,args=(c,u),daemon=True).start(); threading.Thread(target=pipe,args=(u,c),daemon=True).start()
PY
sudo setsid -f python3 $W/fwd.py $HOST ${EXPL##*:} $PORT </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 1
sudo sed -i "s#endpoint = \[\"http://$EXPL\"\]#endpoint = [\"http://$EXPL\"]#" $CONF
